Corridor (box 23,2,9..24,4,21) furnished: birch sideboard on the atrium-glass side (x=23, z=11..13, fronts to the lane), two potted cacti and a birch-pedestal standing lantern as the focal point at z=15..17, three hung lanterns at y=4 under the spruce ceiling. The x=24 lane and every doorway approach stay clear.
room check: OK, walk 23/23 reachable, light min 11, 0 dark cells. make.sh gave a whole build.nbt; the corridor line shows 13 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
Render from above (room.png) reads as a corridor with a sideboard, pots, pedestal and lanterns.
left: Item-frame art not placed: item frames are entities, not blocks, so nothing on the walls reads as art yet.
No warm wood panelling in the corridor: the only free wall run is the 1-wide walking lane, so panelling would close it.
Terrazzo floor is the shell's job (part 1 lays the corridor floor at y=1); this part does not write it.
plan.md and elements.md are not ticked: plan.md's checklist tracks the six parts, not rooms, and elements item 35 (lit rooms) is only partly built by this corridor. Left for the merge.
The 'from inside' view was not rendered: the rooms command produced only the from-above view with --out.

waste.what: Worked out the furniture cell by cell in a text grid (floor and pedestal rows, the y=3 lantern row) and then picked each hung lantern's coordinates by hand against the ceiling rows.
waste.cost: about 13 blocks, plus several checks of which z rows have spruce ceiling at y=5 (z=9..13 and 20..24 only)
waste.tool: a plan detail or room check that lists, for each room box, the air columns that have a block above them (hang points) and the open rows that have none, so lantern and light placement is a lookup rather than a coordinate calculation

waste.what: Checked by eye whether a potted cactus or lantern has a supporting block under it, and whether the pedestal slab can carry the standing lantern.
waste.cost: one render and one room check, no retries
waste.tool: mcd room could report support problems for furniture and lanterns (standing lantern with no top face under it, potted plant with no block under it), not only walkability and light
